name: AP_APINV_APPROVERS
description: This table connects approvers to their invoice components, either the invoice header or the invoice line.  The records are created during the Invoice Approval Workflow process as the workflow proceeds through the list of approvers generated by the Approval Management Engine.  For the most part, the table contains only approvers that either have been notified or need to be notified. While the workflow processes notifications, there will be a brief moment that the Notification_Status will be PEND until the workflow loops to the record and sends the notification.  Once the workflow process for an Invoice finishes, the records related to the invoice will be deleted from the table. Additionally, the user action of Stopping an invoice approval will cause records with a Notification_Status of SENT to be deleted.  As notifications are sent and responded to, the relevant approver/component records will have their Notification_Status updated.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Invoice Id of the Invoice going through approval process.

columns.name: INVOICE_ITERATION
columns.description: Count that Invoice has been through the approval process.

columns.name: INVOICE_KEY
columns.description: The item key used by workflow for the main workflow item type.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number from the Invoice Line going through approval process.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_ITERATION
columns.description:
Count indicating in what order a notification was sent relative to the other
notifications.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_KEY
columns.description: The item key used by workflow for the notification sending sub-process.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_STATUS
columns.description:
Status of record indicating where it is in the notification process.  Possible
values: PEND, SENT, COMP.

columns.name: ROLE_NAME
columns.description:
This is the approvers wf_roles.name value, which essentially identifies the
approver uniquely in wf_roles.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description:
This is the approvers wf_roles.orig_system value.  In Workflow Directory
Services, an originating system is an application that defines a kind of
approver found in wf_roles.  For example, some HRMS persons (from the
per_all_people_f) table appear in wf_roles with the orig_system value PER.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_ID
columns.description:
This is the approvers wf_roles.orig_system_id value.  The combination of the
approvers orig_system and orig_system_id values also essentially identifies the
approver uniquely in wf_roles.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description:
This is the approvers wf_roles.display_name value.  Field value is determined
by AME.

columns.name: APPROVER_CATEGORY
columns.description:
Indicates whether approver should receive a FYI or a response required
notification.  Field value is determined by AME.

columns.name: API_INSERTION
columns.description:
Indicates how the approver was included in the approval list.  Field value is
determined by AME.

columns.name: AUTHORITY
columns.description: Indicates what level approver is on record.  Field value is determined by AME.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS
columns.description:
Indicates status of this approvers approval.  Field value is determined by
AME.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description:
For AME-generated approvers, this field contains the ID that AME assigns to the
action type that generated the approver.  Field value is determined by AME.

columns.name: GROUP_OR_CHAIN_ID
columns.description:
This fields semantics depend on whether the approver belongs to an approval
group or a chain of authority.  In the former case, the field contains the ID
that AME assigns to the approval group.  In the latter case, the action type
generating the chain of authority assigns its chains ascending positive integer
group_or_chain_id values, starting at one.

columns.name: OCCURRENCE
columns.description:
The occurrence field indicates how many times the approvers wf_roles.name
value has occurred in the approvers approval group or chain of authority,
including the present case.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Field value is determined by AME and should only be interpreted by AME

columns.name: ITEM_CLASS
columns.description: Name of grouping seeded in AME.  For example, header, line or distribution.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description:
Unique identifier used by the AME transaction type to identify an item in an
Item Class.

columns.name: ITEM_CLASS_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description:
AME uses this field internally to calculate the approvers approver_order_number
value.

columns.name: ITEM_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description:
AME uses this field internally to calculate the approvers approver_order_number
value.

columns.name: SUB_LIST_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description:
AME uses this field internally to calculate the approvers approver_order_number
value.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description:
AME uses this field internally to calculate the approvers approver_order_number
value.

columns.name: GROUP_OR_CHAIN_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description:
AME uses this field internally to calculate the approvers approver_order_number
value.

columns.name: MEMBER_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description:
AME uses this field internally to calculate the approvers approver_order_number
value.

columns.name: APPROVER_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description:
AME uses the six other order-number fields to calculate the
approver_order_number value by treating them as a six-tuple and sorting them in
lexicographic order.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates the application identifier of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Who column: indicates the identifier of the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the external supplier role.

columns.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates whether dispute process owner is internal or external.

columns.name: CHILD_PROCESS_ITEM_TYPE

columns.name: CHILD_PROCESS_ITEM_KEY
columns.description: Child workflow process item key. For internal use only

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Workflow process item type. For internal use only

columns.name: ITEM_KEY

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
